channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: Glasgow Prestwick Airport profit takes off
item.description: Glasgow Prestwick Airport has recorded a sixth consecutive year of operating profit, driven largely by continued growth in its cargo operations and steady recovery across its wider business. The post Glasgow Prestwick Airport profit takes off first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK launches early engagement for new Light Mobility Vehicle
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has formally opened early market engagement with industry for its future Light Mobility Vehicle programme to replace long-serving platforms such as Land Rover and Pinzgauer across the Armed Forces. The post UK launches early engagement for new Light Mobility Vehicle first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: SAMP/T NG completes long-range trials in France and Italy
item.description: The SAMP/T New Generation long-range air and missile defence system has completed two successful live firing trials in France and Italy. The post SAMP/T NG completes long-range trials in France and Italy first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK defends AUKUS submarine rotation despite SSN pressure
item.description: The Government has insisted it remains realistic and strategically necessary for the Royal Navy to deploy an Astute-class submarine to Australia under the AUKUS partnership, despite concerns over the size and availability of the UK’s attack submarine fleet. The post UK defends AUKUS submarine rotation despite SSN pressure first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: British troops train in Finland for major NATO exercise
item.description: British Army soldiers have been operating deep inside Finland’s frozen forests as part of a large-scale Arctic warfare exercise with one of NATO’s newest members, testing their ability to fight close to Russia’s border. The post British troops train in Finland for major NATO exercise first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Conscription not planned but not ruled out by defence chief
item.description: Speaking to Andrew Marr on LBC, Chief of the Defence Staff Sir Richard Knighton said there are currently no plans for conscription, but declined to rule it out longer term. The post Conscription not planned but not ruled out by defence chief first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Army Reserve recruits waiting around seven months to join
item.description: New Ministry of Defence figures show that prospective Army Reserve recruits face a wait of around seven months from application to entry, highlighting persistent friction in the Reserve recruitment pipeline. The post Army Reserve recruits waiting around seven months to join first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK details how Warfighting Ready Plan 2029 will be delivered
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that the Royal Navy’s Warfighting Ready Plan 2029 will not reach full operating capability at a single, defined moment, describing it instead as an evolving programme designed to adapt to threats. The post UK details how Warfighting Ready Plan 2029 will be delivered first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK Government £150m deal secures Grangemouth ethylene plant
item.description: The UK government has partnered with INEOS in a £150 million joint investment to secure the future of Britain’s last ethylene plant at Grangemouth. The post UK Government £150m deal secures Grangemouth ethylene plant first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: SNP says UK nuclear deterrent is ‘America-first’
item.description: SNP MP Dave Doogan argued that what he described as an “America-first posture” is harming UK defence innovation, particularly in relation to the nuclear deterrent. The post SNP says UK nuclear deterrent is ‘America-first’ first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
